# vastdata_oidc (Data Source)

OpenID Connect

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_oidc" "vastdb_oidc_by_id" {
  id = 1
}

data "vastdata_oidc" "vastdb_oidc_by_guid" {
  guid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
